entities.summary: Jackson Thomas White is an Australian professional basketball player for Mersin MSK of the Basketbol Süper Ligi. He played four seasons of college basketball for the Duke Blue Devils before debuting in the National Basketball League (NBL) in 2020 for Melbourne United. After two seasons in the NBL, he debuted in the NBA in 2022 for the Denver Nuggets and won an NBA championship while part of the Nuggets roster in 2023.
